notes.content:
[b]Added[/b] :

Don't forget to use the Discord to send me feedbacks and report some bugs.

notes.title: Update 0.1.3 : Reset Talent tree & Stats !
notes.content:
[b]Fixes and balancing[/b] : 
- If you die during Berserker Mode, you correctly lose buffs
- Few changing to the Berserker Mode, you now deal more damage depends on your current level when Berserk is active
- Enemies health reduced by 25%
- Rare resource chance for Doe increased by 25% (it was 0%, ooops sorry)
- XP Bar now show you correctly how many XP you need to level up (updates after you defeat enemies)

[b]Added [/b]:
- Tooltip [b]"PRESS (E)"[/b] when you get close to Lore Stone or Odin Statue
- Exit Button to the Lore Stone UI (top right)
- You can now Reset your stats or talent tree by interacting with a [b]Odin Statue (E)[/b], reset either stats or talents will give you back all Coins, Gucks and Level Points you spent [u]BUT[/u] it will cost you 1 little resource pet reset !
- 1 Odin Statue can be found in the first zone, and another 1 at the end of the Cave (after the first bridge)

The next update will be a small content update, with new enemies and maybe access to a small part of the new zone !
Don't forget to use the Discord to send me feedbacks and report some bugs.
Thank you !

notes.title: Patch Note 0.1.2b
notes.content:

- Neutral entities (deer, doe and colored slime) health no longer scale with player's level
- Change stamina refill speed (again) from 1.5 stam per second to 1.33 sps


[b]Added[/b] :
- Gravel pathway at spawn location for every area exit
- Green color for skills already bought in the talent tree
- Talent tree UI now show how many Guck you have "You have x talent points and x Guck"
- Black outline to the enemy health bar

notes.title: Patch Note 0.1.1
notes.content:
Fixes and balancing : 
- Change enemy respawn time : between 30 and 40 seconds (was 10s to 20s)
- Change stamina refill speed (was 1 stam per second, now 1.5 stam per second)
- Fixed issue : now you cannot open inventory or talent tree when you are using the Reading Stone
- Change button "Apply" in the option panel to "Apply & Leave" so now you are leaving the panel by pressing this button
- Teleporting issue after 1st boss.
- Camera/Area issue after 1st boss.
- All enemies damage (bullets, melee) reduced by 1
- Boss attack per second increased by 0.10 (was 0.75, now attack per second is 0.85)

Added : 
- Sound for axe throwing skill
- Actual build number in the main menu
